confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Gdansk and Poland pricing, not from live listings or menus. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately certain; accommodation anchors are less certain and assume July peak-season rates, which can swing widely by date and event calendar. FX uses the RBA 15 Oct 2026 4pm observation, which two search-returned RBA pages agreed on; a 16 Oct 2026 figure appeared in one snippet but was not corroborated.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of mid-sized Polish tourist cities with a historic old town and Baltic-coast summer demand, priced somewhat above inland Polish cities such as Krakow or Wroclaw in peak season. No comparison-city data was retrieved.
